question: Does a three-venue, leave-one-venue-out-consistent adverse-edge state survive the AWS Tokyo visibility clock and mechanically move the current exposure-increasing quote surface without relying on reward selection?

denominator.unit: one strict adjacent BUY-then-SELL historical live quote-log pair
denominator.scope: all quote decisions in valid full-window AWS Tokyo capture intervals
denominator.formal_exact_opportunity_blocker: legacy quote logs have no stable decision_id and use millisecond post-decision log-write time; two ledger days also lack quote rows
denominator.role_rule: latest strictly-prior signed position state derives opener/add/reducing separately for BUY and SELL; quote_decisions.inventory_ratio is absolute magnitude only and is forbidden for role inference
denominator.required_future_merge: either restrict a successor mechanics identity to exact first-add or preregister an all-exposure-increasing value-prediction sibling

clock_contract.reorder_rule: bounded heap reorder by feature_ready_ts_ns; any event arriving behind the emitted watermark fails the complete capture
clock_contract.reorder_budget_basis: outcome-blind engineering budget above the observed recorder queue-age tail; it changes ordering capacity, not signal thresholds
clock_contract.interpretation: current run is log-write-clock sensitivity; exact E6 transport requires native decision_ts_ns instrumentation

fair_price.basis_and_error_updates: strictly past-only before each current output
fair_price.uncertainty_interval: per-venue adjusted fair price plus/minus past tracking standard deviation and one deterministic rounding tick

quote_contract.buy_rule: move exposure-increasing BUY down only when every all/LOO profile identifies negative conservative BUY edge
quote_contract.sell_rule: move exposure-increasing SELL up only when every all/LOO profile identifies negative conservative SELL edge

mechanics_outputs: negative-edge trigger rate and episode duration
10-500ms trigger survival under recorded feature-ready time
potential place/replace and queue-reset upper bounds

non_authoritative_outputs.potential_replace: upper bound only because exact pending-order and ACK state is absent from the immutable capture payload
